name: CLASSIC1
description:
## Description

"A small speaker system that uses an ultra-small baffle and a sealed structure.The Classic1is a speaker equivalent to the improved model of EntryS which became a top seller worldwide.A sealed speaker of approximately the same size is equipped with a new tweeter designed by Carl Heinz Fink himself, who is in charge of design.A 11.5cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This is an original unit that has been improved based on the technical knowledge accumulated by E. J. Jordan. Aluminum metal cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm is driven by a powerful magnetic circuit that can be called an oversize. The combination of sealed enclosure and small-diameter design realizes high-speed and dynamic rise and fall.A 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Polyester fiber made in Japan is used for the diaphragm material and the shape of the dome is changed, and the high-frequency characteristics are expanded from 23khz to 30khz.In addition, laser aperture processing improves input resistance and realizes smooth operation.In the front baffle, the upper and lower units are arranged close to each other, and a very small baffle allows sound to flow quickly and sufficiently to the rear surface. This realizes a state close to a point sound source and a more realistic sound field.The enclosure is sealed and has a natural wood Alder exterior finish.There are screw holes for brackets on the back."

name: CLASSIC5
description:
## Description

"CLASSIC series tall boy type speaker system.Two 14cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.The diaphragm uses a new metal cone with a surface coating to enhance musical expression.Equipped with a high frequency 2.5cm soft dome tweeter.The network section employs a fourth stage LinkWitz-Riley network.MDF material is used for the enclosure and a bass reflex system is adopted.In addition, a virtual coaxial layout has been adopted for the unit layout to improve the sense of sound image localization. It is finished with natural alder material as exterior finish.Bi-wired connection is supported.Cleats are included."

name: CLASSICSUB
description:
## Description

"Active subwoofer from the CLASSIC series.The unit is equipped with 30cm cone type woofer.Pulp cone is used for the diaphragm.It has a built-in 150W power amplifier.MDF material is used for the enclosure and the bass reflex method is adopted, and Mikage stone is used for the top plate, which realizes the beautiful appearance and the deep low sound reproduction.Finished with natural alder material as exterior finish.Equipped with a phase selector switch.The crossover frequency is variable and can be adjusted according to the type of speaker you combine."
